geometryEvidence.summary: Identified supplier execution with unresolved mounting and closed-length evidence.
geometryEvidence.limitations: Supplier identifies MA32x50-SCA, 32 mm bore, 50 mm stroke, M10×1.25 rod thread and Rc1/8 ports, without a manufacturer drawing or CAD. The standalone installation reference retains the saw’s 154 mm shell length and Ø35 barrel / Ø36.5 caps; these shell dimensions, cap lengths, rod diameter, seats, bore depths and port placement are provisional. The 196 × 32 × 36.5 mm listing does not establish extension state or complete mounting geometry. The displayed rod projection matches that nominal overall at extension zero but is not a verified closed length. Supplier has no brand identification; no AirTAC/Festo identity is inferred. Internal piston, seals and magnet are not modeled; optional magnetic switch, rod eyes, brackets and mounting hardware are excluded. Obtain the selected execution drawing or measure the delivered unit before assembly release. The listing delivery text inconsistently mentions MA25x50-SCA; confirm order code before purchasing.
